messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: [SEV2] auth-proxy unusual heartbeat pattern from svcacct=svc-img-ingest -> high auth traffic to /v1/predict (1.2k req/min). spike started 01:58 UTC. alert_id=ALERT-1749123456 link:https://alerts.internal/1749123456

alice_oncall: I'm on it. joining. pulling logs for svc-img-ingest now.

ben_sre: same, seeing a lot of identical auth tokens reused across different src_ips. could be replay or a leaked token.

alice_oncall: logs query I ran: ```sql
index=auth proxy | filter svcacct=\"svc-img-ingest\" | stats count() by src_ip, status
```

ben_sre: sample output: 10.4.5.6: 540 req 401, 52.11.22.33: 480 req 200, 203.0.113.24: 1020 req 200. weird distribution.

sasha_sec: assigning incident code SEC-2026-0317. before we rotate keys, confirm customer impact. if we rotate immediately we may break legitimate ingestion jobs. Claire, any customer reports?

claire_prod: no customer pings yet. our canaries are fine. looks like internal worker traffic pattern (high QPS, repetitive payloads). probably non-customer.

alice_oncall: grabbing a few raw log lines: ```
[2026-03-17T01:59:02Z] svc=svc-img-ingest token=tok_abc123 src=203.0.113.24 path=/v1/predict status=200 latency_ms=42
[2026-03-17T01:59:03Z] svc=svc-img-ingest token=tok_abc123 src=52.11.22.33 path=/v1/predict status=200 latency_ms=45
[2026-03-17T01:59:03Z] svc=svc-img-ingest token=tok_abc123 src=10.4.5.6 path=/v1/predict status=401 latency_ms=3
```

ben_sre: token looks like a long-lived service token. suggest temporary edge block of noisy CIDR while we confirm. I'll add an ip block for 203.0.113.0/24 at edge WAF.

observability-bot: Edge WAF update queued. Current rate for svc-img-ingest -> 1.2k req/min. After block predicted baseline ~120 req/min.

ben_sre: executed block (203.0.113.0/24). monitoring.

alice_oncall: traffic dropped to ~140 req/min now. error rate stable, no customer 5xx. good signal.

security-bot: checking OAuth logs: token id tok_abc123 issued 2026-03-17T01:57:38Z via internal CI pipeline. last used from IPs 52.11.22.33 and 203.0.113.24.

sasha_sec: we need a controlled key rotation. Ben/Jorge coord to push new svc token and add to service, then revoke old. Plan: create new token, deploy to k8s secret, staged rollout to svc-img-ingest, then revoke. do not rotate before new token in place.

jorge_infra: starting rotation now. creating token, pushing to k8s secret `svc-img-ingest-creds` in staging then prod. command: `kubectl create secret generic svc-img-ingest-creds --from-literal=token=REDACTED` will run in next 2m. monitoring rollout.

ben_sre: will keep WAF block in place until we confirm new token acceptance. also enabling short-lived rate limit for remaining IPs to catch any retry storms.

alice_oncall: after new token rolled to prod, running smoke: auth success with new token, ingestion latencies normal.

jorge_infra: old token revoked via internal IAM: `iam revoke-token tok_abc123`. confirmation: revoked at 02:07 UTC.

observability-bot: Post-rotation metrics: auth traffic back to baseline (~110-150 req/min), no increase in 5xx, latency unchanged.

claire_prod: confirming no customer impact reported. product ok with rotation.

legal-bot: quick check on PII exposure: logs inspected for payloads with PII patterns — none found in sampled requests. document findings and keep for forensics.

sasha_sec: good. next actions: full token sweep (search other svc tokens issued around 01:57Z), update runbook with mitigation steps, and create follow-up ticket SEC-2026-0317 with timeline + forensics task.

ben_sre: created follow-up ticket: https://issues.internal/SEC-2026-0317 — assigned to sec+infra.

alice_oncall: marking this thread resolved for now. will leave WAF block for 1h then remove if metrics stable.

pagerbot: ALERT RESOLVED: automated notifier closed the alert. summary: noisy service token used across multiple public IPs -> WAF block + controlled key rotation -> old token revoked -> baseline restored. follow-up: SEC-2026-0317 for full sweep and RCA. :white_check_mark:
